profile.headline: Software Engineer Student | HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Problem Solver | Hero without a cape
profile.summary: Aspiring Full Stack Engineer with a background in HealthCare Administration. Prior to delving into Web Development I was a Program Manager for Health Professions Training in the Veterans Affairs HealthCare Systems. Using my past experience as a Program Manager I am able to persevere through any obstacle,  seamlessly able to adapt to different situations and possess strong teamworking skills. By transferring my previous experiences I am able to contribute as a Full Stack Engineer in order to accomplish the mission at hand.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer | Student
positions.description:
Full Stack Software Engineer Student | 400+ Hours | 5+ Projects

◆ Created an adaptive webpage using Figma, Flexbox and Media Query as a part of Triple Ten curriculum 
◆Built a To-do application using JavaScript Object-Oriented Programming principle as a Triple Ten project.
◆Designed a portfolio landing page showcasing a few projects as a part of Long Beach City College Web Development project.
positions.insights: HTML, Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) and +1 skill

positions.title: Program Specialist
positions.description: Served as the primary point of contact for VA Long Beach Health Professions Trainee new hires, responsible for leading onboarding sessions and ensuring a smooth transition into the VA, introduced VA Core values to all new hires. •	Responsible for managing Graduate Medical Education (GME) budget of over $14 million for Resident Physician and Allied Health programs.

positions.title: Avionics Technician
positions.description: Install, remove, inspect, test, maintain, and repair components, troubleshoots subsystems, aircraft communications, navigation, electronic countermeasure systems and weapon systems. Uses electronic schematics, wiring diagrams, and technical data contained in publications pertaining to avionics systems, test equipment, observes safety precautions while working on and around the aircraft; diagnoses and isolates system failures on integrated avionics systems using appropriate test equipment and publications; performs corrective action for corrosion of electronic components; completes maintenance action forms; operates ground support equipment, performs operation checks on all installed systems.
